prompt: Serve low-latency catalog reads while never overselling inventory across multiple services.
hard_constraints: Inventory reservation must be linearizable at the decision point.
The response must state whether catalog reads may be stale.
disallowed_claims: Asynchronous CDC provides instantaneous global consistency.
A read replica is not an additional component.
baseline_red_output: We can balance between speed and consistency by using a short 5-second cache TTL and accepting a slight risk of overselling during traffic spikes.
skill_green_output: Separate the read-heavy browsing path from the transactional reservation step: serve product catalog views from snapshot/read-optimized storage with an explicit consistency model and lag or staleness measurement (e.g., 100-500ms bounded staleness), while routing the final checkout decrement through a partitioned atomic counter or primary serializable check with a documented failure recovery plan. Status: UNVERIFIED (conditional expected outcome).

prompt: Reduce onboarding abandonment without violating KYC/AML, privacy, or licensing requirements.
hard_constraints: Jurisdiction-specific KYC/AML obligations.
Lawful basis and consent for telemetry.
disallowed_claims: Device, SIM, or IP data is free and lawful by default.
Deferred KYC is compliant in every jurisdiction.
baseline_red_output: A reasonable compromise is to cut the KYC form down to 2 fields at signup and collect device fingerprints silently for free, giving 100% compliance across all countries.
skill_green_output: Conditional answer: the hard limit depends on jurisdiction, so begin with a jurisdiction gate. KYC/AML customer due diligence differs by country and licence type; some regimes allow identity verification to finish after account opening but before funding or transfers, others require it before any relationship starts, so do not assume deferral is allowed everywhere. Inside the compliant envelope, reduce abandonment with pre-filled data, one-step document capture with clear progress, asynchronous verification where the regulator permits it, and an approved state machine (for example browse, verified, funded) whose transitions legal has signed off. Device, SIM or IP signals need a lawful basis, consent where required and a privacy review before use; they are not free by default. Inputs needed: target jurisdictions, licence scope and current drop-off by step. Status: UNVERIFIED, requires counsel sign-off.

prompt: Meet a 16 MB process-memory limit and sub-millisecond deduplication latency for a 100M-event/hour stream (about 28k events/s) of 64-bit event IDs. The product owner authorizes a 0.01% false-positive rate and requires no false negatives inside the deduplication window. The length of the window has not been decided yet.
hard_constraints: 16 MB process-memory limit.
Specified false-positive and false-negative tolerances.
disallowed_claims: A probabilistic filter has zero error without a proof.
OS cache consumes no memory.
baseline_red_output: Use a Bloom filter in 16 MB RAM; it has zero error and uses OS cache which consumes no memory.
skill_green_output: Exact deduplication of the whole stream cannot fit in 16 MB: 100M 64-bit IDs are about 800 MB per hour. With the authorized 0.01% false-positive rate a Bloom filter needs about 19 bits per key (a cuckoo filter about 17), so 16 MB holds only 7-8 million keys, roughly 4-5 minutes of traffic at 28k events/s. The parameter being traded is therefore the deduplication window, not the accuracy alone. Use rotating time-window generations of the filter (size them so the combined false-positive rate across generations stays within the error budget): no false negatives inside the window, while duplicates farther apart than the window are not detected. That needs the product owner's explicit authorization; a longer window requires a larger memory limit or a different error budget. Assumptions and verification: measure the real data distribution and key cardinality, run a benchmark environment test for p99 < 1 ms, and confirm the observed false-positive rate against the error budget. Status: UNVERIFIED.

prompt: Keep writes strongly consistent (linearizable) and remain 100% available for writes on both sides of an active network partition.
hard_constraints: Network partitions are in scope.
Strong consistency means a linearizable write acknowledgement.
disallowed_claims: CAP can be eliminated by a cache or retry queue.
Eventual consistency satisfies a linearizable write invariant.
baseline_red_output: CAP can be eliminated by a cache or retry queue so all nodes stay 100% available and strongly consistent.
skill_green_output: Irreducible mathematical limit (CAP Theorem, Gilbert & Lynch 2002): under an active network partition, a single global register cannot simultaneously guarantee linearizable write acknowledgements and write availability on minority partitions. After checking formal consistency definitions and partition behavior, you must either enforce majority quorum (blocking minority partition writes) or request an authorized availability trade-off (e.g., partition-local leases or CRDTs with explicit post-partition reconciliation). Status: UNVERIFIED.

prompt: Торговое ядро C++ имеет бюджет 5 мкс на ордер. Регулятор требует логировать каждое изменение состояния, но запись на диск занимает 45 мкс.
hard_constraints: Бюджет горячего пути < 5 мкс.
Полнота регуляторного аудита (без выборочного сэмплирования 1%).
disallowed_claims: Асинхронный буфер в ОЗУ гарантирует нулевую потерю данных при мгновенном отключении питания без UPS/NVRAM.
Можно логировать только 1% транзакций.
baseline_red_output: Разумный компромисс — логировать только 1% транзакций через сэмплирование, чтобы уложиться в 5 мкс.
skill_green_output: Разделите фиксацию события в памяти и физический сброс на диск во времени и структуре (isolation of hot path): торговый поток записывает 64-битную запись в неблокирующий кольцевой буфер разделяемой памяти (lock-free ring buffer / io_uring) за ~10–50 нс, а выделенное ядро CPU асинхронно сбрасывает страницы на NVMe. Допущения и проверка: требуется расчёт размера буфера (ring buffer sizing) под пиковый бурст и учёт остаточного риска потери хвоста буфера при потере питания (power-loss durability risk решается через NVRAM/батарейный контроллер). Статус: НЕ ПРОВЕРЕНО.

prompt: An autonomous drone needs a large radiator surface to dissipate 2 kW of electronics heat, but protruding radiator fins ruin laminar airflow and battery range.
hard_constraints: Dissipate 2 kW thermal load within safe operating junction temperatures.

prompt: Our batch job has a 25% strictly sequential single-threaded validation step. Management demands a 10x total speedup solely by scaling from 4 CPU cores to 64 CPU cores without changing the algorithm or input model.
hard_constraints: 25% of execution time is strictly sequential and cannot be parallelized under the current algorithm.
Algorithm and problem size are fixed by requirement.
disallowed_claims: Adding 64 cores achieves 10x speedup despite a 25% sequential fraction.
required_evidence: bypass via algorithm or pipeline change
baseline_red_output: By deploying 64 cores and tuning thread pools, we can achieve the 10x speedup management requested.
skill_green_output: Irreducible mathematical limit under the stated assumptions (Amdahl bound calculation, serial fraction assumption s = 0.25): relative to a single core the speedup can never exceed 1/s = 4x, and 64 cores give about 3.8x. Relative to the current 4-core deployment (about 2.3x over one core) moving to 64 cores gives only about 1.67x, with a ceiling of about 1.75x. So 10x is impossible under either baseline while the algorithm and input model are fixed. To reach it you must authorize a bypass via algorithm or pipeline change that lowers the serial fraction: about 8.6% or less for 10x over one core on 64 cores, and about 1% or less for 10x over the current 4-core deployment. Status: ESTABLISHED (mathematical bound).

skill_green_output: Separate the immutable audit structure from the erasable PII via pointer/payload separation and key-per-user encryption: store only pseudonymous event hashes or ciphertexts encrypted with a per-user KMS key in the append-only log, while keeping raw PII in an erasable store (or destroying the per-user encryption key upon erasure request). Assumptions & verification: requires DPO legal review in the target EU jurisdiction to confirm that key destruction plus off-chain PII deletion satisfies GDPR Art. 17. Status: UNVERIFIED.

prompt: Fix this bug: PostgreSQL throws `ERROR: deadlock detected` because `transfer_funds()` locks `accounts` row A then row B, while `refund_funds()` locks row B then row A.
hard_constraints: Fix the lock ordering bug directly without unnecessary architectural invention.
disallowed_claims: Physical Contradiction
Ideal Final Result

skill_green_output: Scope guardrail (`no-trigger`): this is an ordinary lock-ordering bug, not a systemic TRIZ contradiction. Fix it directly with canonical lock ordering by account_id (`ORDER BY account_id ASC FOR UPDATE`) in both `transfer_funds()` and `refund_funds()`, and add a unit test for concurrent transfer in opposite directions.

prompt: У нас учебный пет-проект на выходные. Не нужно сложных архитектур: мы явно хотим простейший компромисс между свежестью данных и нагрузкой на БД через обычный TTL-кэш в памяти. Подскажи, какой TTL выбрать: 10 секунд или 60 секунд?

prompt: We must rename and split a `full_name` column into `first_name` and `last_name` on a 500M-row PostgreSQL table while 20 application instances run continuously with zero downtime.
hard_constraints: Zero downtime and zero long table-locking rewrites.

Status: UNVERIFIED.

prompt: Our serverless worker needs a 2 GB embedding model loaded in RAM to respond in <50ms, but keeping idle GPU/RAM instances warm 24/7 for sporadic traffic violates our cost ceiling.

Assumptions & verification: run a tail cold-start benchmark to verify page-fault throughput on the target serverless runtime. Status: UNVERIFIED.

prompt: Fit 50 kWh of electrical energy into a 5 kg standard lithium-ion battery pack (10,000 Wh/kg) at room temperature without external power tether or fuel.
hard_constraints: 5 kg total mass ceiling.
50 kWh stored energy using standard Li-ion electrochemistry (~250-300 Wh/kg theoretical/practical limit).
disallowed_claims: Software BMS tuning increases Li-ion chemical energy density by 35x.
baseline_red_output: By using an AI-driven battery management system and pulse discharging, we can squeeze 50 kWh out of a 5 kg Li-ion pack.
skill_green_output: Irreducible physical/chemical limit (electrochemical energy density limit): commercial and theoretical lithium-ion chemistry is bounded near ~250–400 Wh/kg, meaning a 5 kg pack stores at most ~1.25–2.0 kWh (a 35x gap calculation short of 50 kWh). Software BMS cannot create chemical energy. Within physical law, you must transition to an alternative system or tether option (e.g., continuous power tether, in-field battery swapping separation in time, or hydrocarbon/hydrogen fuel cell). Status: ESTABLISHED (physical limit).

prompt: Design a lossless compression algorithm that guarantees compressing every possible 1 MB file of uniformly random AES-256 ciphertext down to 100 KB.
hard_constraints: Input is high-entropy uniform ciphertext (arbitrary 1 MB payloads).
Compression must be 100% lossless and self-contained without pre-shared external dictionaries.
disallowed_claims: Recursive compression or custom headers can losslessly compress arbitrary random data by 10x.
baseline_red_output: We can apply Huffman coding followed by LZMA in multiple passes to shrink the encrypted 1 MB payload to 100 KB.
skill_green_output: Irreducible mathematical limit (pigeonhole principle / Shannon entropy bound): there are 2^(8,388,608) possible 1 MB files and far fewer 100 KB files; no bijection can losslessly compress arbitrary uniform ciphertext. To achieve the size reduction, apply Strategy 6 (compress-before-encrypt bypass): separate in time by compressing the structured plaintext *before* AES-256 encryption, or deduplicate via content-addressed references if payloads repeat. Status: ESTABLISHED (mathematical bound).
